episode_title: Mark Foley: The Unexpected Next Act

real_qa.q: What is The Folson Group and what services does it provide to condominium and co-op boards?
real_qa.r: The Folson Group is a consulting firm co-owned by Mark and Tina Foley that helps condominium and co-op boards manage their buildings more effectively. They help boards run their buildings like a business by reducing budgets, improving energy efficiency, managing capital projects as an owner's representative in commercial real estate, and assisting with finding appropriate property managers when needed.
real_qa.requete: The Folson Group condo co-op board services

real_qa.q: How did Mark Foley transition from a 15-year acting career back to the finance industry?
real_qa.r: After 15 years of acting in off-Broadway, soap operas, and films, Mark woke up one day tired of pursuing acting and decided to return to work. He went back into finance when his girlfriend at the time, now wife Tina, was working in finance and they had an opportunity to break off and start their own investment advisory firm together.
real_qa.requete: Mark Foley acting career finance transition 15 years

real_qa.q: What was Mark Foley's first job and how did it shape his work ethic?
real_qa.r: Mark's first job during college was as a tofu presser at a startup in Fitchburg, Massachusetts, where he would separate curds from whey and press moisture from tofu by hand. The company gave him a $50 bonus every month just for showing up on time, which in 1979 was substantial money, and he appreciated the independent work and above-minimum-wage pay.
real_qa.requete: Mark Foley first job tofu presser Fitchburg Massachusetts

real_qa.q: What did Mark Foley learn from acting auditions that he applies to his professional work today?
real_qa.r: Mark learned from acting instructors that when auditioning, the role belongs to you—own it and do it without begging for the job. He applies this principle to his work today, believing that you are the expert and know more than 99% of people about what you do, so you should approach it with confidence and ownership.
real_qa.requete: acting auditions confidence professional ownership Mark Foley

real_qa.q: What challenges did Mark Foley face managing an investment advisory firm during the 2008 financial crash?
real_qa.r: During the 2008 crash, Mark and his team managing money for individuals and major wire houses experienced significant difficulty as people lost money on paper and the team did not get much sleep for several months. As an investment manager, he was only as good as the last quarter's performance, meaning good quarters brought happiness for three months while bad quarters brought misery for similar periods.

guest.bio_context: Mark Foley's career spans Wall Street, a 15-year acting career in New York including off-Broadway, soap operas, and film roles, and a return to finance where he co-founded an investment advisory firm managing money for individuals and major wire houses including Morgan Stanley, Merrill Lynch, and Credit Suisse. He is now co-owner with his wife Tina of The Folson Group, a consulting firm serving condominium and co-op boards.
